en_title: Rumored Lucia Actress Goes Viral After Dodging Swarm of GTA 6 Comments During Livestream
cn_title: 《GTA6》传闻演员直播避谈粉丝评论
subtitle: 谜底尚未揭晓
opus_summary: 传闻将出演《GTA6》Lucia的Manni L. Perez直播时避开粉丝追问，引发热议。Rockstar尚未确认大多数演员阵容，《GTA6》将于11月19日发售。

paragraphs.en: Manni L. Perez, the actress long rumored to be playing Lucia in GTA 6 , has gone viral after dodging a swarm of comments from Grand Theft Auto fans during a recent livestream.
paragraphs.cn: 长期被传将饰演《GTA6》Lucia的演员Manni L. Perez，近日因在直播中巧妙避开《侠盗猎车手》粉丝的大量留言而走红。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar Games has refrained from confirming the vast majority of the cast of next month's new GTA game, but as if there was ever any doubt, that hasn't stopped ravenous fans from piecing a list together themselves. Perez is one name theorists have talked about for years, so she took a few minutes to let thousands of viewers get to know her while masterfully dodging a swarm of GTA 6 comments along the way.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar一直没有确认下个月推出的《GTA》新作中绝大多数演员，但这似乎丝毫没有影响粉丝们热情十足地自行拼凑演员名单，仿佛这件事从来就没有过悬念。Perez是粉丝多年来一直讨论的人选之一，于是她抽出几分钟，让数千名观众了解自己，同时一路巧妙避开大量《GTA6》相关评论。

paragraphs.en: Reaching a peak of more than 2,100 viewers on a six-month-old Instagram account with just nine posts, Perez spent her 12-minute livestream just talking about her life growing up in a "small, rural, redneck-y" town. She lives in a studio apartment with a dog, loves to cook, grew up driving trucks, and as far as everyone else is officially concerned, she definitely will not be the star of the so-called biggest video game of all time in a little less than a month.
paragraphs.cn: Perez的Instagram账号开设仅六个月，只发过9条帖子，但这场12分钟的直播观看人数一度超过2,100。她聊起自己在一个「小而偏僻、乡村气息浓厚，还有点乡巴佬风格」的小镇长大的经历。她和一只狗住在单间公寓里，喜欢做饭，从小就开卡车；而从目前公开确认的信息来看，距离发售不到一个月，她当然不会是那款所谓「史上最大电子游戏」的主演。

paragraphs.en: "But yeah, no, I'm not rich. I'm a regular person," Perez said when responding to fans who assumed she was wealthy. "I live in a small studio apartment, which I love. I have my tiny, little itty-bitty kitchen, and it's just me and my dog. I do everything on my own, and I've done everything on my own for a very long time, and I love it, and I'm very grateful. I have a family that loves me, and I'm just feeling like I'm in a really good place, where I am in my life."
paragraphs.cn: 有粉丝以为Perez很有钱，她回应说：「不过，嗯，不，我不富有。我就是个普通人。我住在一间小小的单间公寓里，我很喜欢那里。我的厨房特别小，家里就我和我的狗。我什么事都自己做，而且独自承担一切已经很久了。我喜欢这样，也心怀感激。我有爱我的家人，而且我觉得自己目前的人生状态很好。」

paragraphs.en: "I want a green truck," she said with a smile while ignoring the horde comments mentioning "Lucia" and "GTA 6." Some responded that, no, actually, she doesn't live alone, because she has Jason to keep her company. Others were subtler, asking if she'll be playing Rockstar's latest or if she's just "ready for next month." Despite the steady flow of responses begging her to confirm her alleged role – which would be guarded under a strict non-disclosure agreement, even if it were real – Perez only acknowledged users commenting about anything else.
paragraphs.cn: 面对评论区不断刷屏的「Lucia」和「GTA6」，她笑着说：「我想要一辆绿色卡车。」有人回应说，不，她其实并不是独自生活，因为还有Jason陪着她。另一些人问得更含蓄，只问她会不会出演Rockstar的新作，或者是否「已经准备好迎接下个月」。尽管评论接连涌来，纷纷求她确认传闻中的角色——即便传闻属实，她也会受到严格的保密协议约束——Perez只回应了谈论其他话题的用户。

paragraphs.en: Keep in mind that this all comes from years of clues gathered by fans, but Rockstar's lack of confirmation doesn't mean there's nothing to suggest Perez is playing Lucia in GTA 6. As others have highlighted , the actress has a history of live-action and voice roles. She has credits for single episodes of shows like Jessica Jones, The Blacklist, and Law & Order: Special Victims Unit. Funnily enough, she also played a blackjack dealer in Grand Theft Auto Online.
paragraphs.cn: 需要注意的是，这些猜测都来自粉丝多年来搜集的线索。Rockstar没有确认，并不代表完全没有迹象表明Perez会在《GTA6》中饰演Lucia。正如其他人指出的那样，她曾出演真人影视作品，也担任过配音演员。她曾在《Jessica Jones》《The Blacklist》和《Law & Order: Special Victims Unit》等剧集中各出演过一集。有意思的是，她还在《GTA Online》中扮演过一名21点荷官。

paragraphs.en: Her place in Rockstar history may be given a bump when GTA 6 launches for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S next month, November 19. If you're wondering who might be playing Lucia's partner in crime, Jason, fans have long speculated that Modern Family and Grey's Anatomy actor Dylan Rourke filled the role, but he, too, has yet to be confirmed.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》将于下个月11月19日登陆PS5和XBOX Series，Perez在Rockstar历史上的地位或许也会随之提升。如果你好奇谁可能会饰演Lucia的犯罪搭档Jason，粉丝们长期以来猜测，这个角色由《摩登家庭》和《实习医生格蕾》演员Dylan Rourke出演；不过，他同样尚未得到确认。

paragraphs.en: Who has been confirmed, whether Rockstar and any likely NDAs like it or not, is Stephen Root, who said he will be seen playing drug trafficker Brian Heder . Otherwise, we might need to wait until launch to see the full cast, so don't go sending messages to any actors just yet.
paragraphs.cn: 不管Rockstar和可能存在的保密协议是否乐意，已经确认参演的人选是Stephen Root。他表示，自己将在游戏中饰演毒贩Brian Heder。至于其他演员，我们或许要等到游戏发售才能看到完整阵容，所以现在先别急着给任何演员发消息。

paragraphs.en: Fans may have tracked down the voice actors behind one of the biggest game launches of all time, but it's par for the course when it comes to Grand Theft Auto players. One fan spent three months charting planetary positions just to try and learn when trailer 3 would premiere (they were wrong). Another fan measured oxygen levels to try and achieve the same feat (they, too, were wrong).
paragraphs.cn: 粉丝或许已经找出了这款史上最大规模游戏发售之一背后的配音演员，但这对《侠盗猎车手》玩家来说早已见怪不怪。一名粉丝花了三个月绘制行星位置图，试图推算第三支预告片何时发布（结果猜错了）。另一名粉丝则测量氧气含量，想用同样的方法得出结果（他也猜错了）。

paragraphs.en: Either way, GTA 6 marketing is continuing to ramp up . While we wait these last few precious weeks, you can see why some fans are expecting a sweep at The Game Awards 2026 . You can also learn more about the love and care Rockstar put into its new video game , but don't forget to read up on IGN's interview .
paragraphs.cn: 无论如何，《GTA6》的宣传仍在持续升温。在等待发售前最后几周的同时，也不难理解为何有些粉丝期待它能横扫2026年TGA。
